wordProblems.q: Grace watches a cartoon for 34 minutes and then plays outside for 45 minutes. How many minutes did Grace spend in all?
Ruby needs 90 minutes to finish a puzzle. Ruby has already worked for 75 minutes. How many more minutes does Ruby need?
Sam buys 5 packs with 6 stickers in each pack, then shares all the stickers equally with 4 friends, so 5 children share them. How many stickers does each child get?
A garden is 5 metres long and 8 metres wide. How many square metres is the garden?
Leo earns $12 each week for 4 weeks. Leo buys a ball for $39. How many dollars does Leo have left?
Ella puts 30 marbles into bags of 10 marbles each. Ella finds 14 more marbles. How many marbles does Ella have in all?
Each bus holds 37 children. 3 buses are full, and 20 more children walk. How many children are going on the trip?
A recipe needs 6 eggs for one cake. A baker makes 5 cakes and uses 23 eggs for something else from the same box. How many eggs does the baker use in all?
Each pizza has 8 slices. There are 5 pizzas. The family eats 8 slices. How many slices are left?
Omar buys 4 books for $5 each and 2 pens for $8 each. How many dollars does Omar spend in all?
Ava practises piano for 5 hours and then for 17 more minutes. How many minutes did Ava practise in all?
A theatre has 10 rows with 9 seats in each row. 34 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
A teacher has 4 packs with 6 crayons in each pack. She shares all the crayons equally among 3 tables. How many crayons does each table get?
James gets $8 pocket money every day for 6 days. James spends $14 on a toy. How many dollars does James have left?
A cyclist rides 35 kilometres each day for 2 days. After 39 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to ride?
A garden is 12 metres long and 4 metres wide. How many metres of fence are needed to go all the way around it?
A shop buys toy cars for $3 each and sells them for $9 each. How many dollars of profit does the shop make on 8 toy cars?
Jack plans to read 16 pages every day for 6 days. Jack has already read 25 pages. How many pages are left to read?
There are 4 teams with 7 players in each team. How many players are there in all?
A baker makes 4 trays with 6 cookies on each tray. She shares all the cookies equally among 6 classes. How many cookies does each class get?
A table is 5 metres long and 7 metres wide. How many metres of ribbon are needed to go all the way around the table?
Sara buys 2 rulers for $6 each and 3 erasers for $8 each. Sara pays with $40. How many dollars of change does Sara get?
A runner runs 24 kilometres each day for 4 days. After running 65 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to run?
A child buys cups of lemonade for $5 each and sells them for $9 each. How much profit does the child make on 6 cups?
A baker makes 4 trays with 8 scones on each tray. She shares all the scones equally among 4 friends. How many scones does each friend get?
Ella practises violin for 3 hours and 23 minutes on Saturday and for 1 hour and 39 minutes on Sunday. How many minutes did Ella practise in all?
Chloe earns $9 each week for 5 weeks and then spends $35 on a board game. How many dollars does Chloe have left?
A classroom library has 4 shelves with 12 books on each shelf. The teacher lends 34 books to another class. How many books are left in the library?
Leo and 2 friends earn $36 washing cars together. They share the money equally. How many dollars does each child get?
A teacher buys 5 packs with 10 pencils in each pack. She shares all the pencils equally among 5 classes. How many pencils does each class get?
